name: seal-release-sequence
intent: Three concentric rings disengage outward on a frozen stagger, then the locked glyph snaps to open last.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run to disengage the seal rings.

reducedMotion.behaviour: All three rings appear already expanded and the open glyph is shown immediately

acceptance: Exactly three rings at radii 46/34/22 disengage outer-to-inner on staggerMs [0,120,240]
Each ring expands to scales 1.38/1.32/1.26 with stroke thinning over ringAnimMs 300 — not opacity fade
Open glyph snaps after the last ring (glyphMs 160); locked glyph rotates out
Replay resets all data-disengaged before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows UNLOCKED with all rings expanded immediately
